subject: France 1970 starting spirits and removal paths
scope: Read-only design audit. No native engine test claimed.

starting_spirits.name: The Fifth Republic
starting_spirits.notes: Executive final net from baseline: PP +0.02, bureaucracy cost -0.02, stability unchanged. Parliamentary final net: stability +0.07, PP -0.15, bureaucracy cost -0.08. Both require public_service.

starting_spirits.name: The Unfinished Settlement of Grenelle
starting_spirits.notes: Contract final: stability 0, efficiency gain +0.03, social cost +0.08. Statute final: stability 0, efficiency gain +0.06, social cost 0, police cost +0.04.

starting_spirits.name: Uneven Modernisation
starting_spirits.notes: Final infrastructure construction modifier is +0.03; removal also sacrifices the starting industrial-complex construction bonus +0.05.

starting_spirits.name: Oil-Intensive Growth
starting_spirits.notes: Excludes the preceding transport_choice focus. Route-selected transport and energy modifiers also affect effective energy use and generation.

starting_spirits.name: The Postcolonial Settlement

assets: 1 infrastructure in state 56, with 1 shared slot

starting_spirits.notes: This uses the same prerequisite path as Grenelle relief, followed by housing and a political choice. Civic Settlement adds bureaucracy cost -0.02. Recognition route ends at stability +0.07; Amnesty route ends at stability +0.01 and war support +0.03. Relative to the starting -0.02 stability, these are +0.09 and +0.03 respectively.

starting_spirits.name: After the 1969 Devaluation
starting_spirits.notes: Temporary and not reapplied; excluded from blanket hardening.

recommendation.focus: Stage only the Fifth Republic transition if its terminal choice is considered too early: the existing first choice should grant partial institutional relief while preserving the starting spirit; a later meaningful follow-through should replace it and remove any intermediate modifier to prevent stacking.
avoid: Broadly increasing fees or delay on already-funded relief routes
Treating every starting spirit as purely negative
Changing the mixed temporary franc spirit without an identified problem
